note: offload-a2-route-diag-1118 (RUN FIRST, diag, PREPARED, NOT RUN, dry-run checked; est ~45 min game time, measurement only, heavy tools: no timing verdict). Splits the route residual (rebaseline-1116c route 65 / 53 / 11 ms/s BP / IP / SV) into sim-thread sync plans by reason (own Replan / PlanFromPoint / ReplanFromPosition IC vs Route.Plan sync fallbacks) and waits behind route jobs, and counts how many own A10 STARTs are for unseen routes (the only ones docs/288 §4 may move). Decide (docs/288 §3): build/time Kinds bit 1 or 2 for unseen NPCs only if arShadow x mean arSyncUs of that kind >= ~3 ms/s on BP or IP; if the waits (haUs[0] + haUs[2]) dominate, no new Kinds work (P6 stays stopped, ADR 0005). Apex + bridge stack (Bin state apex).

match: route async A10: Kinds=7 KindsMode=0 ForeignKinds=4 ForeignKindsMode=1, hooked mask 7, WatchdogKind2=0, own gate unseen routes only, Mode 1 needs H2Ic + RefcountGuard
noMatch: route async A10: Kinds=0 KindsMode=1 ForeignKinds=4 ForeignKindsMode=1, hooked mask 4, WatchdogKind2=0, own gate none (Kinds=0)
route async A10: Kinds=7 KindsMode=1 ForeignKinds=4 ForeignKindsMode=1, hooked mask 7, WatchdogKind2=0

match: OK   route phases SyncPlans: sim-thread sync plans timed (lines >= 50 ms, LogFallbackMs)
noMatch: FAIL route phases SyncPlans: Route_PlanLocked site not timed, sync plans stay untimed

match: SKIP route async A10: needs the async route path
FAIL route phases SyncPlans: Route_PlanLocked site not timed, sync plans stay untimed
noMatch: OK   route phases SyncPlans: sim-thread sync plans timed (lines >= 50 ms, LogFallbackMs)
